title: taskbar-restore v1
description: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Harbor\taskbar-restore.json. Written by the dock just before it turns on the taskbar's auto-hide (only if auto-hide was off), so the original setting can be put back after a crash or reboot. Deleted once a restore is verified, never while the session is ending.

stateBefore.description: SHAppBarMessage(ABM_GETSTATE) before Harbor changed it: ABS_AUTOHIDE = 1, ABS_ALWAYSONTOP = 2.

createdUtc.description: When the record was written, UTC, to the second.
